'''Arrowhead''' was an area of [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]] located at the tip of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and was also known as the '''Inner Core'''. Inclusive of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] between the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], it ranged from [[Vento system/Legends|Vento]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

==History==
The ancient area known as the [[Tetrahedron]] was the first inklings of modern spacefaring civilization, with the planets of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], along with the [[Ginn Jump/Legends|Ginn Jump]], forming its "points". From there, the planets started the eastwards expansion of the Slice, with the Tetrahedron afterwards forming the Slice's "Arrowhead", and the cradle of what would become the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The region included the cream of the Core Worlds, with those closer to Coruscant being stereotyped as increasingly bragging about their status.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Arrowhead Command]] was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet assigned to the defense of the Arrowhead. It was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]] from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Whirlwind (Imperial-class)|''Whirlwind'']].<ref name="Despoilers2">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' clearly identified the Inner Core as the Arrowhead. However, in endnotes for ''The Essential Atlas'', [[Jason Fry]] identified the Inner Core as the [[Southern Core]].
